demand_repair_analysis.node_purpose: Reconsider only the R9 Demand thesis and second strongest counterargument that promote same-quarter orders and revenue into an observed order-cohort conversion.
demand_repair_analysis.input_scale: One immutable R9 Demand workpaper, its three prior feedback receipts, one new digest-bound cross-role feedback receipt and unchanged evidence, numeric, relation and gap authority.
demand_repair_analysis.required_outputs: One substantive natural Demand revision that preserves the two same-quarter signals but removes any claim that recognized revenue converted those orders and retains cohort, timing and conversion-rate gaps.
demand_repair_analysis.schema_burden: The repair view carries the full prior workpaper, four feedback receipts, semantic relation rules and locked Evidence, NumericFact, Relation and remaining-gap references.
demand_repair_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: Very high because a false cohort conversion changes fulfillment-quality judgment and could make Writer present observed conversion where only contemporaneous signals exist.
demand_repair_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R9 reused Demand without a new analysis call and independent reassessment found one exact L1 residual; R7 natural Demand analysis completed within the same 32000-token profile.
demand_repair_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max with max_tokens 32000 for one genuine role-local financial-semantic reconsideration.
demand_repair_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one analysis call and zero retry; transport failure, length truncation or off-scope reasoning preserves immutable R9 and terminates the attempt.

demand_repair_submission.node_purpose: Map the single new Demand natural draft into the strict specialist workpaper without adding or changing any evidence authority.
demand_repair_submission.input_scale: One Demand draft plus its compact validated repair view, prior workpaper, four feedback receipts, strict nested schema and unchanged authority sets.
demand_repair_submission.required_outputs: One valid Demand workpaper whose thesis and strongest counterarguments obey the no-cohort-conversion boundary while all authority references remain identical.
demand_repair_submission.schema_burden: Nested thesis, claims, mechanism, alternatives, counterarguments, gaps, confidence and change conditions must validate against the exact repair-context digest.
demand_repair_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapper can erase the natural correction, reintroduce conversion language or smuggle authority, so strict local validation and exact authority-set comparison remain mandatory.
demand_repair_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R9 strict submissions completed under the 8000-token non-thinking profile and the prior Demand authority-ceiling path proved fail-closed local validation.
demand_repair_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled with max_tokens 8000 because financial analysis is already contained in the natural Demand draft.
demand_repair_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one Tool Call and zero retry; invalid JSON, schema drift, authority drift or truncation terminates and preserves the consumed attempt.

lead_recheck_analysis.node_purpose: Compare the one newly repaired Demand workpaper with the five byte-identical R9 workpapers and decide whether any catalog-bound challenge remains before independent reassessment.
lead_recheck_analysis.input_scale: Six validated workpapers with only the Demand digest changed, one deterministic challenge catalog and no new evidence, retrieval or external-source authority.
lead_recheck_analysis.required_outputs: One materiality-ranked Lead draft that either proceeds to independent reassessment or identifies only unresolved catalog members without authoring facts or repairs.
lead_recheck_analysis.schema_burden: Lead must reason across six nested workpapers and select only deterministic challenge identifiers while preserving the distinction between same-quarter coexistence and cohort conversion.
lead_recheck_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: R9 Lead falsely declared the cohort recheck satisfied, so this one cross-role review has high false-proceed risk and cannot replace independent L1/L2 assessment.
lead_recheck_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R9 Lead completed naturally under this 32000-token profile but missed the Demand contradiction; the new input removes that single diagnosed residual.
lead_recheck_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max with max_tokens 32000 for cross-role comparison of the six current workpapers.
lead_recheck_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one Lead analysis and zero retry; off-catalog, incomplete or truncated output preserves the bounded frontier and does not unlock Writer.

lead_recheck_submission.node_purpose: Map the Lead recheck into one strict catalog-bound coordination decision without changing its routing judgment.
lead_recheck_submission.input_scale: One Lead draft plus the deterministic challenge catalog compiled from the six post-Demand-repair workpapers.
lead_recheck_submission.required_outputs: One valid accepted and deferred challenge partition, rationale and next state consistent with the current workpaper set.
lead_recheck_submission.schema_burden: Identifiers must be unique catalog members and next state must match the accepted and deferred partition under the strict coordination schema.
lead_recheck_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapper error could falsely route to evaluation or hide an unresolved conflict, so invalid output remains terminal and Writer stays forbidden.
lead_recheck_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R9 Lead strict submission completed with this 8000-token non-thinking profile and zero retry; no R10 Lead node has run.
lead_recheck_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled with max_tokens 8000 for strict mapping only.
lead_recheck_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one Tool Call and zero retry; invalid identifiers, inconsistent state, authority drift or truncation terminates the attempt.

owner_decision_basis: R9 completed all six authorized Provider nodes but independent reassessment found one L1 Demand contradiction outside the originally routed role. The zero-call successor binds that exact R9 workpaper digest, rolls forward all prior Demand feedback, preserves five other workpapers byte-for-byte and proves the first fresh frontier and four-node ceiling.
known_boundary: This decision authorizes no call by itself. After full regression, clean commit and repository-aware preflight it may support one fresh R10 authority over immutable R9. R10 allows only one Demand analysis and strict submission pair followed by one Lead analysis and strict submission pair, at most four new Provider calls. It authorizes no S1/S2, retrieval, external source, Candidate promotion, retry, fallback, Writer, S3 acceptance, generalization, publication or release. Independent L1/L2 and content reassessment remain mandatory before any Writer decision.
